Translation of a letter sent to the Special Branch,
S.M.P. and received at 10 a.m. February 25, 1932.
------------------
Shanghai, 2 p.m. February 25.
Officer in charge Special Branch.
    I beg to inform you that I was originally a member
of the Communist Party but now I am no longer connected
with it. I left the Communist Party as I realised that
its members are simply murderers and incendiaries. They
are a group of desperadoes. They endeavoured to deceive
the poor and working classes in Shanghai and utilize those
students who do not pursue their studies properly for
the purpose of furthering their own ends. The Communists
have become very active since the September 18th Incident
(Japanese occupation of Manchuria) and the recent Shanghai
incident. They are planning to create disturbances.
I am writing to apply for your permission to be engaged as
a secret detective. I am willing to supply you with
information concerning the plans of the Communist Party.
I wish to bring the following points to your attention :-
1. I will, upon being appointed a secret detective, resume
my activities as a member of the Communist Party and
obtain for you the details of its organization and
plans.
2. After appointment I will hold my original position (?)
and live in the same way as I did before. I will not come
to the Police Station or work in company with any
of your permanent staff openly. I shall keep my mission
absolutely secret from outside people.
3. Owing to my heavy expenses, I apply for a monthly
salary above $200.00.
    Our first meeting should not take place in the Police
Station. Owing to the approach of the anniversary of the
International Unemployment Movement (Feb.25), I suggest

2.
that our first meeting should take place between 1 and 1.30 p.m.
February 24 in front of the Post Office in Coochow Road.
(I shall wear a student costume, blue foreign-style trousers.
No headgear. If the weather is extremely cold I shall
put on a brown overcoat).
(Sd) Chu Ching Zang 朱经农

年 月 日 No.

王世芳君鈞：

敬啟者：僕人西河朱桂堂，於昨日下午五時許，由貴局門前經過，忽被貴局巡警二人住，謂僕人形跡可疑，強行搜身，並將僕人所攜皮包奪去，內有現洋三十元、手錶一隻、鋼筆一支、名片數紙。僕人再三聲明係貴局職員家屬，彼等置若罔聞，反將僕人推倒在地，拳腳交加，致僕人頭破血流，昏絕於地。經路人救醒，扶至同仁醫院救治，現雖脫離危險，然精神受創極深，夜不成寐，食不甘味。竊思貴局為維持治安起見，對可疑之人加以盤詰，原屬職責所在，然亦應顧及人情，不可濫用威權，任意毆辱。況僕人係貴局職員家屬，縱有嫌疑，亦應通知貴局查明，何得擅自施以暴力？此等行為，不特損傷僕人身體，抑且損害貴局名譽。為此，特函達貴局，務請澈查嚴辦，以儆效尤，而維法紀。至僕人所失財物，並請如數發還，以免損失。臨穎神馳，無任盼禱。

（一）被經過。據僕人面稱：當時彼等二人，一持木棍，一持皮鞭，不由分說，即向僕人身上亂打，僕人躲避不及，頭部被擊，頓時暈倒。迨後甦醒，已身在醫院矣。

（二）被搜情形。據僕人云：彼等先將僕人皮包搶去，然後強行搜身，將僕人衣袋翻遍，所有錢幣、物件，悉被取去。僕人哀求归还，彼等不允，反加毆辱。

（三）損失數目。計現洋三十元、手錶一隻（金殼）、鋼筆一支（金尖）、名片二十餘紙。以上各物，皆僕人平日所用，一旦失去，諸多不便。

（四）要求事項。（甲）嚴懲肇事巡警，以申國法；（乙）發還所失財物，以彌損失；（丙）登報道歉，以雪冤屈。

以上各節，均屬實情，並無虛飾。伏乞 貴局察核施行，不勝感禱之至。

肅此。敬請
台安

弟 朱桂堂 頓首
十月廿五日
